candidates.description: This feature vector represents common German noun and adjective suffixes or root endings centered around variations of "icht" and "richt."
This feature vector represents common German noun suffixes, particularly those forming feminine abstract nouns.
German modal and auxiliary verbs expressing necessity, possibility, or volition.
This vector activates strongly for the letter 'ä' and words or subwords containing the character 'ä' in various languages.
This feature vector represents negation and quantifier concepts, primarily in German and English.
These tokens are German modal particles and adverbial intensifiers that modulate the tone, emphasis, or pragmatic meaning of a sentence.
This vector represents common German adverbial and prepositional prefixes used in compound words.
These tokens represent common German pronominal adverbs, prefixes, and connective roots frequently used in compound words and prepositional phrases.
This vector represents common German verbs and their inflected forms.
German adjectival suffixes and verb inflections.
